This article is a stub. Spectronics, of Edmonton, was the service company that [Seagull
Enterprises](seagull.md) contracted in 1978 to maintain timing and scoreboard systems, including
those installed for the Commonwealth Games.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
